description: This file defines an interface for configuring entity tags within the persistence layer of a MongoDB-related service. It includes a method to retrieve the cache size for streaming tags, and an enum specifying default configuration values and paths.

classes.name: TagsConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for entity tags, including cache size.

classes.name: TagsConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration values related to tags, specifying default values and configuration paths.

methods.name: getStreamingCacheSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the cache used for streaming tags, with each stream maintaining its own cache.
